name: coaching-and-teaching
description: Coaching as teaching — John Wooden's Pyramid of Success, practice design, feedback quality, instructional economy, and the craft of deliberate skill development. Covers the difference between knowing the game and teaching it, Wooden's actual practice methods as documented by Gallimore and Tharp, skill progression through part-whole teaching, the four-to-one positive feedback discipline, and the habits that distinguish effective coaches from merely knowledgeable ones. Use when designing practices, improving instruction, mentoring young coaches, or framing sport leadership as an educational activity.
